listing.name: Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock / GH3 macOS Recomp
listing.original_game_title: Guitar Hero III: Legends of Rock
listing.summary: Build the upstream Apple Silicon player from your own Guitar Hero III PC installation.
listing.download_block_reason: Open the publisher’s release to download GH3 Builder. The inspected kit includes Apple Silicon tools and libraries built for macOS 26.5.

steps.title: Open GH3 Builder on Apple Silicon
steps.instruction: Download the publisher’s v0.1.0 ZIP and open GH3 Builder on macOS 26.5 or later. The builder needs Apple’s Command Line Tools and internet access to fetch the checked Visual C++ runtime. Keep the builder separate from the game app it creates.

steps.title: Build from your own PC installation
steps.instruction: Select your own compatible Guitar Hero III 1.3.1 folder with GH3.exe, DATA/, AWL.dll and fmodex.dll. The builder checks the specific executable and FMOD hashes. The developer tested with BetterGH3. Choose a destination for the generated app, then use Play after the build completes. Keep the original folder in place for the default linked setup.

steps.title: Preserve your app and profile before rebuilding
steps.instruction: Close the game and back up ~/Library/Application Support/gh3, including AspyrConfig.ini and the drive_c saves. Keep your original installation and custom songs separately. A build replaces Guitar Hero III.app at its selected destination and recreates the shared game links in linked mode. A separate destination protects the previous app. Linked builds still share the same profile and game links. Keep the generated app and its game files for your own use.

warnings: The publisher describes this builder as experimental and unnotarized. Review the publisher and this package before using Apple’s per-app approval to open it.
